name: 所属と連絡操作を添える友だちの行
prompt:
Create a compact Lighthouse-style Japanese friend row on an exact 390×88 px white canvas. Use the native preview as the authority for all wording, positions, spacing, shape, typography and colors. Use the original source crop only to understand the one-line friend/contact pattern; follow the preview for the Japanese adaptation.

Match the preview closely: a pale mint rounded horizontal row inset about 16 px from the sides and 8 px from the top; a 40 px green-tinted avatar circle with the initial 佐; the dark bold name 佐藤 ゆう; the small pale mint affiliation chip 交流会; and separate white circular phone and message action buttons with restrained green outline icons. Use Meiryo and the native compact type sizes. Keep alignment and gaps as shown in the 390×88 preview.

The source portrait is intentionally replaced by the Japanese initial avatar in the approved native adaptation. Use the preview’s 交流会 chip rather than adding source-only labels or logos. No semantic hyperlink is present in this row: the name is plain text, 交流会 is an affiliation badge, and the phone/message icons are action controls. Do not turn any text blue. Do not add URLs, buttons with labels, extra text, source photo, keyboard or decoration.
reviewNotes: v001 compared at 390x88 with native preview. Japanese initial 佐, dark 佐藤 ゆう, green affiliation chip 交流会, and green call/message actions are present. Native node2 has no semantic hyperlink, so no blue text is applied. Minor residuals are about 2px shorter row height and 4px left shifts for name/actions.
